title: Director Escalation Request
description: The director's own request to the user for a stronger model or higher reasoning effort, issued when the director itself is stuck. The director does not change its own model. No high-risk decision or speculative implementation proceeds before the user responds. See ESCALATION-PROTOCOL.md.

blocked_decision.description: The specific design, integration, or risk decision the director cannot confidently make right now.

confirmed_facts.description: What is actually established, with evidence.

unresolved_conflicts.description: The specific conflicting results, designs, or subagent reports the director could not reconcile.

attempts.description: What the director already tried to resolve blocked_decision at the current model/effort.

risk_if_continued.description: What could go wrong if the director proceeds on a guess instead of escalating (data loss, security, broken shared contract, botched deploy, etc.).

review_scope.description: What the upgraded model/effort should actually review or decide — bounded, not 'the whole project'.

forbidden_scope.description: What the upgraded model/effort must NOT do — e.g. restart the whole project, redesign unrelated modules. Escalation re-examines only the blocked decision and its directly related scope.

last_passing_checkpoint.description: The last known-good state to fall back to if escalation does not resolve the block.

exact_next_prompt.description: The precise question or task the director wants the upgraded model/effort — or the user — to resolve.
